directors.name: Ace Norton
directors.bio: Ace Norton (yes, that’s his real name) is an Asian American artist and filmmaker born and raised in Venice, California.
directors.abstract: Norton creates visuals on a variety of media platforms including music videos, commercials, fashion films, and movies. Norton also is known for his drawings, sculptures, and frequently commissioned installation work.

projects.title: The Magic of Everyday Living
projects.blurb: A celebration of how good design makes everyday life better.

projects.title: Get Hy With Me ft Hailee Steinfeld
projects.blurb: Ace brings fashion, comedy, and flawless hair together in a playful, tongue-in-cheek take on “getting high” with Nexxus. Featuring the effortlessly cool Hailee Steinfeld, the film is a bold, high-energy celebration of bigger, bouncier hair.

projects.title: Blackpink x Rosé
projects.blurb: PUMA partners with BLACKPINK’s Rosé in this stunning director’s cut, helmed by Ace Norton. Shot in the heart of Seoul, Korea, this campaign takes off in style as Rosé stars in her first campaign for PUMA since being announced as the brand’s global ambassador.

projects.title: Style
projects.blurb: With cars being an extension of a driver’s personal style, Ace’s Lexus campaign speaks boldly to going all-in on experiencing the things people are passionate about.

projects.brand: La Mer x Ana de Armas
projects.title: Wildcard
projects.blurb: Ace Norton teams up with Ana de Armas in this stunning director’s cut for La Mer – exploring the boundaries of surreal and unexpected beauty.

projects.title: Spend More Time Living
projects.blurb: A partnership with Farfetch promises Gucci at your doorstep in 90 minutes or less. Is it a feature-length publicity stunt or the future of e-commerce?

projects.title: Struttin
projects.blurb: Ace Norton brings his unique style to Old Navy, commemorating the brand’s 30th anniversary with a nostalgic journey through its rich history, promising a blend of nostalgia and creativity that captivates viewers and evokes the excitement of spring fashion.

projects.title: Matusalem
projects.blurb: Ace finds the balance between fast paced choreography and symmetrical art direction in this celebratory spot for Jose Cuervo.

projects.title: Synchronicity
projects.blurb: This film is about synchronicity: two identical twins doing the exact same thing, at the exact same time. Ace plays with timing, symmetry, and balanced frames in this film for Garrett Leight.

projects.title: The Art of Inspiration
projects.blurb: Ace embarks into a hilarious exploration of Snoop Dogg’s psyche through painting for the unveiling of the new line of Happy Socks.

projects.title: It's Me
projects.blurb: Watch Commondeer’s mic-dropping female empowerment anthem for mega-retailer Bon Prix. Bad b$tches, yoga posing septuagenerians, surfing plus size girls, and unapologetic artists defy the status quo and prove why they’re anything but boring housewives.

projects.title: Soda Lime Smash
projects.blurb: Ace teamed up with Smirnoff to launch their new Soda Lime Smash. His fresh vision came jam packed with fun provocative energy, a new take on a classic brand we thought we knew.

projects.title: Sell + Buy
projects.blurb: Ace Norton directorially challenges the rules of fashion with this outrageously bold spot for Rebelle.com.

projects.title: RXL
projects.blurb: Ace goes to India and introduces armpit holes to the world for the unveiling of Old Spice’s new scent in this hilarious spot.

projects.title: Guilty of Great Taste
projects.blurb: Ace Norton directs this tasty caper for Vin Vault. Rated R for “Responsibly,” the theatrical film trailer is replete with explosions, poolside antics, safe robberies, interrogations, and the occasional “It’ll work” moment. As sinfully delicious as its namesake, this spot goes down easy.

projects.title: Not So Silent Night
projects.blurb: Ace was approached by Smirnoff to shoot their new Christmas campaign that stars one of the most influential LGBTQ advocates Laverne Cox. With an overall aim to help continue normalizing the transgender conversation, Ace creates a lavish Christmas world where anyone from anywhere is invited.

projects.title: Wonderfilled
projects.blurb: OREO kicks off “Wonderfilled” Dunk Challenge with three celebrity superstars. Can you dunk like Shaq? We don’t mean dunk a basketball, we mean dunk an OREO cookie. That’s the premise of a celebrity-studded campaign for OREO from The Martin Agency.

directors.name: Alessandro Pacciani
directors.bio: Alessandro Pacciani is best known for his action packed car campaigns, short films and for his game cinematics work.
directors.abstract: His works have garnered assorted honors including a UNESCO award, as well as showcased at the Institute of Contemporary Arts in London. Prior to his directing career, Pacciani developed a strong foothold in design, animation, and visual effects. Those skills allowed him to establish his own signature look through blending digital technology and high-octane visuals with cinematic storytelling.

projects.title: Not Built For Easy
projects.blurb: Shot entirely in-camera with real stunts and zero AI, the work takes a defiantly analogue stance at a time when much of the category is veering towards digital.

projects.title: VR46 ft Valentino Rossi
projects.blurb: A symphony of speed, precision, and passion — born on the racetrack and brought to life by director Alessandro Pacciani. This BMW M film pays tribute to racing legend Valentino Rossi and the raw power of the M4 CS Edition VR46.

projects.title: Beginnings
projects.blurb: Alessandro skillfully weaves between the narrative and automotive space in this beautiful short film for Acura “Beginnings” is the winner of “Best Commercial Film” London Motor Film Festival.

projects.title: Vroom
projects.blurb: The spot, directed by Alessandro Pacciani, sees Team Toyota drivers Christopher Bell, Antron Brown, and Kaylee Bryson behind the wheel of their respective Toyota vehicles alongside everyday motorists driving themselves from one awe-inspiring scenario to the next.

projects.title: Mission R
projects.blurb: Alessandro Pacciani creates transformative modern visuals that showcase the glamor and exquisite technology of the all-electric Porsche Mission R concept.

projects.title: Revuelto
projects.blurb: Directed by the gifted Alessandro Pacciani and filmed in sunny Spain, the two-minute trailer for the Lamborghini Revuelto has set the automotive world ablaze with its breathtaking digital effects and cutting-edge artistry.

projects.title: Get Up & Go
projects.blurb: NAPA propels the nostalgia of car culture for the modern road—fuel for every driver’s passion.

projects.title: Bred for Track
projects.blurb: Alessandro demonstrates the awesome power of Audi.

projects.title: Factory
projects.blurb: Alessandro highlights the high-performance abilities of the BMW M4 as it drifts through the streets with intense speed.

projects.title: C63 Getaway
projects.blurb: Alessandro takes the idea of a car heist to new heights in this clever film for Mercedes.

projects.title: Shaped By Performance
projects.blurb: WINNER “Best Commercial Film” International Motor Film Awards.

projects.title: Wasteland
projects.blurb: An apocalyptic world starts to look a little bit brighter when a man stumbles upon an Abarth sportscar lying around in the rubble.

projects.title: Birth of Solomon
projects.blurb: Alessandro unveils the new Mortal Shell video game in this cryptic teaser, “Birth of Solomon.”

projects.title: Factory
projects.blurb: Alessandro takes us on a high speed chase through city lights in his film “Playground” for Jaguar.

projects.title: Launch Trailer
projects.blurb: Pacciani cinematically reveals the release of Dark Souls II.

projects.title: Approved
projects.blurb: This emotional spot by Alessandro Pacciani reminds us that a Porsche will always be a Porsche.

directors.name: Anton Tammi
directors.bio: Anton is a Finnish born director and photographer known for cinematic, emotionally driven work that blends live action with a distinctive, modern approach to visual effects.
directors.abstract: He gained global recognition after directing a saga of music videos for The Weeknd, including Blinding Lights, which won MTV Video of the Year. He transitioned into visually ambitious commercial work, marked by bold experimentation with color and a refined, artistic cinematography. Whether directing music icons or future facing global campaigns, Anton brings vision, taste, and technical fluency to every project, consistently shaping work that feels true to his style and never seen before.

projects.title: 'Blinding Lights'
projects.blurb: Global superstar The Weeknd in a fast-paced portrait of Sin City after dark, built on rhythm, magic and blinding lights.

projects.title: Black Opium ft Zoë Kravitz
projects.blurb: Zoë Kravitz at the center of a bold celebration of night, movement, and desire.

projects.title: Collection No. 4 Short
projects.blurb: Corporate codes reversed through mind bending visuals, where masculinity and tailoring drift in and out of sync with reality.

projects.title: Designed For Your Mind
projects.blurb: A meditative visualization of motion, where electric performance meets clarity and control.

projects.title: The Weeknd “Open Hearts” Trailer
projects.blurb: A visionary immersive music journey with The Weeknd, weaving sound and space into a surreal cityscape of motion and emotion.

projects.title: Wherever You Go, We Go
projects.blurb: A bold return to the outdoors, reframing heritage through modern scale and motion.

projects.title: Neon Legacy feat. Roger Federer
projects.blurb: When a legend meets a legend, Mercedes-Benz embodies performance through precision and presence, carrying a legacy that extends beyond the road.

projects.title: Closer to the Journey feat. Ludwig Göransson
projects.blurb: A poetic exploration of travel and sound, where camera, composition, and editing create rhythm as palpable as the journey itself.

projects.title: A Watch Is Born
projects.blurb: A precise study of watchmaking, where human mastery and engineering discipline meet in perfect harmony.

projects.title: A290
projects.blurb: An electric vision of speed, shaped through transitions, perspective, and rhythm.

directors.name: Jabu Nadia Newman
directors.bio: Jabu Nadia Newman is a genre-defying director born in Cape Town and now based in New York who takes inspiration from traditional forms of African storytelling to create contemporary, colorful, comedic and visually impactful films exploring ideas around sexuality, gender, race, class and politics.
directors.abstract: Newman’s honest narratives encourage the characters in her films to be active participants in the storytelling, to tell their own stories, in their own way. She is inspired to bring her conscious aesthetic to commercial filmmaking, championing equal representation both in front of and behind the camera.

projects.title: Supersport
projects.blurb: Inside Jabu Nadia Newman’s sleepy World Cup fever dream for Supersports TV and Canal+

projects.title: Mind Reader
projects.blurb: Shot on 16mm in New York, Alice Phoebe Lou’s “Mindreader” opens a three-part visual series exploring love in motion and memory.

projects.title: Live It To The Max
projects.blurb: With ‘MAX IT,’ Orange rolls out a super-app through an inclusive campaign rooted in the belief that the smartphone is the gateway to modern digital living.

projects.title: Scamandla!
projects.blurb: What do Leo Prinsloo, Digital Vibes and the Tembisa 10 have in common? Nando’s. In her brave, smart, and hilarious Nando’s campaign inspired by true events – Jabu takes aim at scam culture and fake news in ‘Scamandla’.

projects.title: Untamed ft Miranda Lambert
projects.blurb: In her ‘Untamed’ campaign for Lone River Ranch Water ft. country music star Miranda Lambert – Modernity and Tradition find harmony on screen whilst following the theme of exploration, adventure, and individualism commonly associated with the traditional Wild West.

projects.title: Open Forum
projects.blurb: A rallying symbol for Gen Z. On the occasion of the re-launch of Adidas’ iconic Forum model, Jabu imagined an impactful 3 part episodic campaign to honor the legendary shoe.

projects.title: Scrambled Eggs
projects.blurb: With all the edginess of a classic heist film – Moonchild Sanelly and her gang of accomplices run wild and cause egg-related havoc all over town in Jabu Nadia Newman’s narrative music video for the South African artist and dancer’s highly infectious track ‘Scrambled Eggs’.

projects.title: Short Film
projects.blurb: An Afrofuturist cipher reframing black cultures through poetry, movement and dance – The Dream The Refused Me is a film split across four aesthetically distinct chapters that ties together myths, attitudes, and rituals from across Africa.

directors.name: Jake Dypka
directors.bio: ®Jake Dypka is a director based in London. He started his directing career by making martial arts training DVDs for a publishing house in Chichester.
directors.abstract: He went on to win the Young Directors Award at Cannes just shortly after becoming a ‘serious’ director. From there he went on to make the opening film for the Saatchi young directors showcase in Cannes the following year.  His work engages the fantastical and balances brilliantly stylized set design and humor into a blend that he has developed into a voice that is uniquely his own.  His film “With Hollie” was viewed over 10 million times in the first week of its release online and it has been downhill for Jake ever since.

projects.title: The Movement
projects.blurb: Jake Dypka applies his signature craft-first approach to the campaign, blending large-scale filmmaking with his trademark dry humour.

projects.title: End The Waiting Game
projects.blurb: Humorous waiting room chaos meets modern healthcare convenience.

projects.title: Bum Burn
projects.blurb: Sprite tackles scorching temps with a global summer campaign, and crisp refreshment is just a twist away.

projects.title: Hard to Hide
projects.blurb: Unlock Your Best Self: Dive into Jake Dypka’s fun and vibrant world for HIMS, where confidence meets care! This campaign shows how easy it is to tackle hair loss, skincare, and men’s health with style.

projects.title: Putt Putt
projects.blurb: Got a Tinder date? Now you can share the details with friends ahead of time. It’ll be like they’re really there. Playful, innovative, and packed with humor, this spot captures the essence of modern dating while making sure no one misses out on the fun, even from a distance.

projects.title: Clothes Love All Humans
projects.blurb: Individuality and self-expression are brought to life with style in Klarna’s “Clothes Love All”. This boldly vibrant spot highlights Klarna’s smooth shopping experience with flair and personality.

projects.title: Spicy Chicken
projects.blurb: Jake Dypka turns up the heat for Burger King’s Limited Edition Spicy Chicken Burger. This playful spot showcases the spicy new addition in true BK style, blending bold visuals with just the right touch of fun, leaving viewers craving more.

projects.title: Lightboost
projects.blurb: Dypka crafts a dynamic and energetic spot to highlight Samsung’s Light Boost technology, which tackles the issue of jarring overexposure in low-light settings. Embracing the slogan “Flash Sucks,” the piece uses rapid cuts and montage editing to emphasize the unpleasantness of blinding brightness.

projects.title: Larger Than Life
projects.blurb: Go Big with OnePlus! In his larger than life launch film for the new OnePlus Nord Smartphone, Jake Dypka makes a visual play on the adage ‘bigger is better’.

projects.title: Alexi the Alien
projects.blurb: Alexi the extraterrestrial returns, using the Babbel app to overcome isolation and connect with his new Earth community. Before long, he’s cracking jokes at dinner parties and making friends with his neighbors, mastering the language—and life—on his new planet.

directors.name: JONES
directors.bio: Jones’ body of work consistently bridges concept and craft, anchored in emotional truth and shaped by instinct.
directors.abstract: Collaborating with clients like Meta, Netflix and Nike, Jones blends cultural fluency, human depth and pulse-raising energy to every project – often working direct-to-client to transform bold brand visions into impactful, emotionally-charged work, transforming strategy into soul.

projects.title: One Movement
projects.blurb: Peloton redefined—bold, inclusive, and rooted in culture.

projects.title: Sweat is Glory
projects.blurb: Turning sweat into a raw and stylized spectacle for Gatorade.

projects.title: New Ways
projects.blurb: Real people and tech fuse to make Meta’s Quest Pro human.

projects.title: In Your Bag
projects.blurb: JONES captures Paige Bueckers in her element— through silhouetted shots, game-time energy, and style in every frame.

projects.title: Deep feat Steph Curry
projects.blurb: Kaiser Permanente’s quiet gut-punch—Steph Curry’s inner world revealed.

projects.title: The Fencer
projects.blurb: A night drive with Lincoln—sleek precision, pure calm.

projects.title: Blood
projects.blurb: Nothing, especially blood, holds us back in this Bodyform performance.
The most iconic images in history become a living, breathing narrative thread in a tribute to the birth of modern photography.

projects.title: Boxers feat. Max Verstappen
projects.blurb: Human strength and racing power unite in Esso’s visceral spot.

projects.title: Palmeiras x Wherever it is Green
projects.blurb: Wherever you go, nature and vitality follow in this spot for Puma.

projects.title: Work Out Your Way
projects.blurb: Transforming real workouts into a celebration of motion for Peloton.

directors.name: Madeline Clayton
directors.bio: Madeline brings a fresh perspective on emotional storytelling to commercial filmmaking. With an effortlessly authentic and vibrant visual language; every frame, every story and every character is rooted in honesty and connects with audiences for its lifelike, tactile quality.
directors.abstract: Through her attention to dialogue and performance, ability to work with non-actors and the sensory experience she curates with the use of sound and music, Madeline tackles big emotional themes with intimacy and relatability. Her unique approach will often leave audiences with chills, tears or smiles, creating genuine impact and brand awareness across the board.

projects.title: Confidence Where It Counts
projects.blurb: A fresh take on male confidence—rooted in calm, care, and the everyday rituals that make you feel like yourself.

projects.title: Anyone Can Be Super
projects.blurb: The “Anyone Can Be Super” campaign spot for DC Studios and Amazon finds quiet power in everyday kindness. The film unfolds in gentle, human moments that show how even small acts can carry heroic weight. It’s a grounded, heartfelt take on what it truly means to be super.

projects.title: Drawn Together
projects.blurb: With Madeline Clayton’s direction and Geoff McFetridge’s warm animation, this Ad Age Top 25 campaign reminds us that together is the best place to be.

projects.title: Pet Rock
projects.blurb: This campaign beautifully captures the deep, personalized care at Mayo Clinic Health System. Clayton brings the ad to life, showcasing how patients are cherished as individuals, not just numbers on a chart.

projects.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
projects.blurb: Portraying common challenges women face from birth to adulthood — AXA offers a refreshing perspective on gender typecasting, encouraging us to rethink our views and presenting an optimistic vision of the potential for progress.

projects.title: Feels Like Home Again
projects.blurb: Separated by oceans, a mother and son reunite after four years—an emotional embrace that reflects the universal bond of family and the airline that helps bring them home.

projects.title: Walk Your Way
projects.blurb: A playful and energetic film that celebrates the impact we can have by embracing ourselves with confidence. A young girl is inspired to dance down the street when she sees a young woman moving and grooving her way through LA.

projects.title: Piggy Bank
projects.blurb: A hardworking single mother and her young daughter share a role-reversal moment. This heartwarming ad captures the innocent child-like perspective of familial love by showcasing the affordability of IKEA.

projects.title: Comfort
projects.blurb: Celebrating the many forms of comfort—whether it’s a favorite teddy bear, a warm embrace, or the simple touch of a hand.

projects.title: Pressure
projects.blurb: Gillette Venus’s ‘Pressure’ commercial is a visually stunning piece that captures the serene beauty of the ocean, drawing a powerful connection between the smoothness of the waves and the effortless glide of a perfect shave.

projects.title: She'll Be Right
projects.blurb: Bronze Cannes Lion winner. The powerful campaign, ft. Actress Miah Madden for International Women’s Day, calls on women to embrace a risk-free future.

directors.name: Martin Krejci
directors.bio: Martin Krejči is a cinematic visionary whose filmmaking is defined by his commitment to precision and craft. His classical foundation has fuelled an acclaimed career operating at a level most directors spend a lifetime chasing.
directors.abstract:
With work that refuses to be categorized, yet consistently inspires, he moves seamlessly between performance-driven storytelling, sharp comedy and technical innovation. With strong visual aesthetics and heightened narratives, he elicits unforgettable performances from the likes of Helen Mirren, David Beckham, Mel Gibson, Chloe Sevigny and more.
His conceptual approach to filmmaking elevates ordinary concepts into extraordinary cinematic experiences. Krejči constantly redefines his creative boundaries and lives on the right side of unpredictable.

projects.title: Cookie Problem
projects.blurb: A snack-sized story with bite: a wry reminder that even the smallest things (like a missing cookie) can trigger the grandest dramas.

projects.title: iPhone SE
projects.blurb: Transforming a mundane day into a high-octane automotive experience through the power of iPhone.
Handcrafted stop-motion animation brings the history of Adidas and Adi Dassler the man behind the legendary brand to life.
For Gillette’s “effort comes easy” Super Bowl campaign, Martin used  all in camera plates combined together in 2D Flame with the master himself, Barnsley.
Transforming ambitious practical set pieces into a seamless cinematic experience.
Blending celebrity storytelling and local character with David Beckham as guide.

projects.title: Drumroll
projects.blurb: Executing an ambitious one-take driven by practical effects and subtle CG enhancements.

projects.title: Listen to the Chocolatier
projects.blurb: Martin tells the story of global soccer star and Hershey native Christian Pulisic through the craft of a Hershey chocolatier.

projects.title: Mel Gibson
projects.blurb: Mel Gibson stars in this noir promo for the renowned Karlovy Vary International Film Festival.

projects.title: The Wave
projects.blurb: A masterclass in editorial precision, weaving together four international productions into a seamless narrative.
Martin crafts an escalating, energy-fueled night to remember for Smirnoff.

projects.title: Silver Dollar
projects.blurb: Showcasing his comedy chops, Martin excels in his execution of this simple, yet highly effective spot.
Shot documentary-style, this piece is grounded, raw and emotional.
An explosive portrayal of practical effects in this orchestral film.

projects.title: World Cup
projects.blurb: An escalating spectacle of fun with football icon Thomas Müller.

projects.title: Bike Ride
projects.blurb: Mads Mikkelson takes us on a filmic ode to the iconic Danish beer, Carlsberg.
Movie magic and visual effects bring a package’s epic journey to life for DHL.

projects.title: Trailer
projects.blurb: Martin brings a coming-of-age fantasy to life alongside Chloë Sevigny in this feature film.

directors.name: Michael McCourt
directors.bio: Michael McCourt’s directing career began nearly a decade ago when a passion for fine art photography developed into a love for live action filmmaking.
directors.abstract: After graduating from the University of Miami, Michael traveled west to Southern California where he began honing his skills while working in the fields of film, music video, commercials, and episodic television. In the process he began to expand his hands-on approach to filmmaking by becoming actively involved in the editorial part of the creative process. Spending countless hours refining projects in post has helped him develop an eye for directing that is constantly approaching film with a comprehensive, “big-picture” perspective that he feels helps put the maximum amount of production value on the screen where it belongs.

projects.title: Fire
projects.blurb: Michael engages the audience with fiery visuals in his film for Sentry, leading us through a precarious narrative with an unexpected twist at the end.

projects.title: Unseen Emergency
projects.blurb: This powerful piece for Rocket Mortgage shows how community  emergencies that are visible can be fixed abruptly, but the full scope of homelessness can often go unseen.

projects.title: Part One
projects.blurb: In this three-part series for Maine tourism, Michael McCourt does more than capture moments of local faces. He dives into each character’s story, creating compelling and memorable portraits set to the backdrop of Maine’s beautiful landscapes.

projects.title: Being A Teacher
projects.blurb: Micheal approaches camera work with childlike curiosity in this piece for Crayola, which dives into the important role of teachers that goes beyond simply teaching from a book.

projects.title: Human Invention
projects.blurb: Michael finds a beautiful balance between vast scale through landscapes and close intimacy through human connection in this heartfelt commercial for Bayer.

projects.title: Take Note
projects.blurb: Michael’s fierce directorial approach to Crayola’s new spot marks the beginning of a more modern look for the brand, embracing a confident and proud Generation Y audience.

projects.title: Made For This
projects.blurb: Michael McCourt’s fast paced work for Northern Tool embraces the relentless curiosity and power of doing something yourself, with the help of the right tool for the job.

projects.title: Love Your Home
projects.blurb: Michael McCourt gives us a compelling new energy conservation campaign to generate awareness for natural gas.

projects.title: The Way We Move
projects.blurb: Michael McCourt’s understanding of the human spirit shines through in this energetic collaboration with Budweiser to salute the summer months. This rhythmic film reminds us all that a life is only as important as the people we live it with, and for that Budweiser raises their glass.

projects.title: Be The Muse
projects.blurb: Micheal crafts a fast paced yet delicate story between two bike messengers meeting by chance in the midst of the loud hustle of New York City for Bose.

directors.name: Oliver Würffell
directors.bio: Oliver Würffell is an award-winning director based in New York. His work fuses cinematic storytelling with a deeply human sensibility — exploring atmosphere, emotion, and the tension that lives beneath the surface.
directors.abstract:
He creates high-end commercials for luxury brands and premium clients — including BMW, Audi, Mercedes-Benz, Cadillac, Land Rover, Shiseido, and Red Bull — translating brand identity into visually rich, emotionally resonant film experiences.
His film “855 – How to Quit Opioids” stands as a defining example of that sensibility applied to work with real human stakes — earning Titanium & Gold at Cannes Lions, alongside honors from D&AD, ADC, the New York Festivals, CLIO, and the Red Dot Awards, among others. The project reflects Oliver’s belief that the most powerful commercial storytelling doesn’t sell a feeling — it excavates one.

projects.title: Choose What Drives You
projects.blurb: Our choices reflect who we are.

projects.title: Life Unfolded
projects.blurb: Where craft meets artistry, the Mazda CX-80 becomes a powerful expression of identity through Oliver Würffell’s lens.

projects.title: Vision Neue Klass
projects.blurb: Directed by Oliver Würffell, this BMW commercial unveils the forward-thinking BMW Vision Neue Klasse, symbolizing a new era in mobility, blending digital experiences, emission-free driving, and sustainability while upholding BMW’s core values.

projects.title: CANNES LIONS WINNER
projects.blurb: Turning the object of addiction into a way out. This multiple award winning film directed by Oliver Wúrffell shows an innovative approach with the goal to help people who are struggling.

projects.title: For You And The Clubs
projects.blurb: Oliver Würffell directs this dynamic spot for Rewe featuring people of all ages engaging in diverse sports, capturing the essence of the brand.

projects.title: Challenge the Xtreme

Set in the streets of London, the electrifying chase scene showcases unmatched speed, precision, and style. The film celebrates the spirit of “Challenging the Extreme,” inspiring thrill-seekers to push their limits and ride toward greatness.

projects.title: Megan Rapinoe
projects.blurb: Oliver Würffell teams up with Activist / US team captain Megan Rapinoe to boldly celebrate female diversity through athleticism and performance art in his new fashion-forward campaign for Shiseido.

projects.title: Welcome to the 8th Dimension
projects.blurb: Oliver Wurffell joined forces with Audi to launch their Global film for the new Q8. This high speed film brings together the best of both worlds – the mind blowing elegance and pure energy.

projects.title: Anthem
projects.blurb: A campaign for Cadillac marks the end of the brand’s 4-year-old “Dare Greatly” ad campaign and the beginning of a new “Rise Above” tag line.

projects.title: A Mirror into the Future
projects.blurb: BMW trusted Oliver Würffell to create this beautiful film introducing their new concept car i4.

projects.title: Finding Your Own Place
projects.blurb: Oliver dives into world-class freediver Kimi Werner’s mind in this branded film for Mercedes.

projects.title: Ideas Start The Future
projects.blurb: Oliver was chosen to collaborate with Audi in this fresh spot introducing the new electric Audi RS.

projects.title: Fuse
projects.blurb: Oliver brings humanity to automotive while demonstrating the heartbeat of the car in this film “Fuse” for Porsche.

projects.title: XT5
projects.blurb: Oliver captures the extreme capabilities of the XT5 by having it racing a fighter jet through a desert landscape. A beautiful display of fresh stye from a classic brand.

projects.title: Reveal DC
projects.blurb: Oliver Würffell unleashes his directors cut for the all new Nissan Frontier.

projects.title: Move Earth
projects.blurb: The global launch film for the first ever BMW X3. Some things you never apologize for, like all the reasons to love the level of power Oliver was able to capture in this X3’s performance.

projects.title: Freedom is Calling
projects.blurb: Audi worked with Oliver to create this stunning film exploring the love and turbulence between a man, a woman, and their vehicle.

projects.title: Move Earth
projects.blurb: BMW races across a road, tackling snow, mud and dirt, Oliver shows directorial mastery in every terrain the X4M comes in contact with until it gets to the edge of a cliff … You might want to turn there.

directors.name: Paul Butterworth
directors.bio: Paul Butterworth is a multi-award winning advertising Director specialising in SFX, Surrealism, performance, transitions and food.
directors.abstract:
He has worked throughout the world including UK, USA, South America, Europe, The Middle East, North Africa, China and Australia; with brands such as Lurpak, BMW, EE, BAFTA, Betty Crocker, KFC, Carex, Ecco, Jacob’s Creek and Etihad.
In a former life, Paul worked as an advertising Producer and Line Producer with some of the industries most iconic Directors, as well as in production departments on movies such as James Bond Casino Royale and City Of Ember.

projects.title: Feed Your Imagination
projects.blurb: Paul Butterworth teams up with Rewe to showcase their fresh produce with exceptional attention to detail.

projects.title: Breakfast
projects.blurb: Must there be hell in a healthy breakfast? Paul combines live action and tabletop in series of upbeat spots for Kashi.

projects.title: The Nations Favourite TVC
projects.blurb: This spot showcases Richmond’s range of sausages in all of their sausage glory.

projects.title: Protecting The Nation
projects.blurb: Carex has been at the heart of Britain’s hand care for over 25 years, ‘Protecting the hands of the nation’ celebrates this with an engaging new spot directed by Paul Butterworth. The experience of washing your hands is elevated into an inclusive experience, showing that Carex is here to protect all hands of the nation.

projects.title: DC
projects.blurb: Closeups of spices and food combine to show how a pinch of pure seasoning and spice can make a meal legendary.

projects.title: Guardians of Little Feet

directors.name: Per-Hampus
directors.bio: Per-Hampus grew up in a village in northern Sweden.
directors.abstract:
He discovered filmmaking through his passion for snowboarding and started filming his eclectic friends at the local ski-hills and makeshift mini-ramps. Before long he was following the top athletes around the world creating iconic snowboard films in some of the earliest forms of branded content.
His years in snow culminated in the creation of Nike’s 2014 flagship film, “Never Not.” A ground-breaking sports documentary, reaching the top of the iTunes charts worldwide and starring olympic gold medallist Sage Kotsenburg. Much like the nordic landscape that shaped him, Per has a uniquely beautiful vision for the world. Capturing all nuances of life with an authentic and cinematic approach.

projects.title: The Unanswered Children

projects.title: After Dinner

projects.title: What's Your Power?

projects.title: Come to Life
projects.blurb: “Come to Life” is a celebration of Bahamian culture and an invitation to the rest of the world to discover this unique blend of island charm and creative sophistication, raw energy and deep history. Per-Hampus takes the viewer on a visual journey that provides an intimate peek into Atlantis Resort and the spirit of the Bahamas through the soul of fifteen Bahamian artists, musicians and designers.

directors.name: Scott Perry
directors.bio: Scott Perry is a director with a gift for distilling culture into striking, emotionally-resonant narratives. Blending a documentary-style sensibility with cinematic precision, his work is humanistic and observational, spanning high-fashion campaigns, branded content, and commercial storytelling that forges a deep connection with audiences.
directors.abstract: Scott previously worked at MTV and served as creative director at FADER’s in-house agency, Cornerstone, where he collaborated with artists like Burna Boy, Dua Lipa, and Lil Nas X to shape their visual identities. His commercial portfolio includes campaigns for luxury fashion powerhouse Diesel and The New York Times’ award-winning Independent Journalism for an Independent Life series, directing the poignant Vera. Perry has also partnered with Nike, Google, Amazon, Beats by Dre, Asics, McDonald’s, YouTube and more, consistently drawing out nuanced emotion while maintaining a distinct and compelling brand aesthetic.

projects.title: Family Matters
projects.blurb: This documentary-style campaign showcases the real stories of Amazon employees, whilst highlighting the range of benefits offered.

projects.title: Gel Lyte V
projects.blurb: The craft behind the ASICS GEL-LYTE V meets the rhythm of real life — stitched with precision, worn with purpose. Built in the details, lived in the moments.

projects.title: How Trips Are Made
projects.blurb: This campaign captures the magic of seamless travel, where Google Trips weaves every detail of your journey into a perfect tapestry. From cherished destinations to effortless itineraries, your next adventure is not just planned—it’s at your fingertips, ready to unfold.

projects.title: Queens Lead
projects.blurb: Scott Perry’s electrifying Nike spot celebrates the power of heroes in shaping future champions. Following four young women inspired by trailblazing sportswomen, the film showcases determination, ambition, and the legacy that fuels the next generation of Queens.

projects.title: Independent Journalism for an Independent Life

projects.title: Make Your Miracle

projects.title: For Successful Living

directors.name: Trevor Clarence
directors.bio: Trevor Clarence has been described as having the wit of Cristiano Ronaldo and the body of Will Ferrell.
directors.abstract: He loves making ads. People tend to love making ads with him. He has a past as a successful stand-up comedian, feature filmmaker, actor, musician and yoga teacher. Well, maybe not a successful yoga teacher, but he has some certificates.

projects.title: Honest

To illustrate how universal the frustration really is, a modern day living room is changed into a medieval battlefield, with a basic coffee table transformed into a giant flat-pack catapult.

directors.name: Zac Ella
directors.abstract:
Zac Ella is an exceptionally skilled and versatile director. With over ten years of experience, he is one of those rare breeds of
directors who are genuinely good at it all. A Multidiscipline master, Zac enjoys live-action and animation, often mixing the two to create unique mixed-media mashups. Zac has experience working with big-name celebrities; his friendly demeanor is sure to disarm even the most ‘challenging’ talent. He’s full of infectious energy and his shoots are always a fun place to be. As well as creating big TV campaigns for some well known household names (TikTok, McDonalds, Sports Direct and ITV), Zac has his finger firmly on the pulse of the zeitgeist when it comes to creating cool content.

info.mission: Our mission is to combine fresh ideas and an enduring work ethic to produce progressive content of the highest caliber. With a focus on exploring true, human connections, J O J X promises to deliver work that creates a lasting bond between brands and viewers. In today’s ever-changing world, our method is simple: to transform a vision into an unrivaled cinematic experience.
